titulo: What Happens When Fast Food Becomes Illegal? #FastFood #WhatIf #Economy #Animation #stickman
descripcion:
Imagine pulling up to your favourite drive-thru only to find it wrapped in yellow police tape. What would actually happen if the US government permanently banned all fast food overnight?

In this short animation, we break down the massive economic and physical shockwaves of outlawing junk food. It is not just about losing your midnight burger craving. Millions of minimum-wage workers and teenagers would lose their jobs instantly. The massive agricultural supply chains for beef, potatoes, and cheese would completely collapse, leaving farmers with millions of tonnes of rotting surplus.

Physically, the country would go through a massive, collective withdrawal. With the sudden drop in daily sugar, salt, and processed fat intake, millions of Americans would experience severe headaches, fatigue, and irritability for weeks. We explore whether a total ban would actually fix the obesity crisis, or if it would just create a highly lucrative underground black market for smuggled fried chicken and chips.

Watch to see how the US economy and human biology would react to the sudden death of the drive-thru.

If you like fast-paced economic breakdowns, wild what-if scenarios, and stickman science, hit that subscribe button for more animated shorts!
